why: The belted camel suit is formal enough for a bank interview (7-9) and stays classic, with warm tones and a soft scarf near her face. The deeper chocolate pumps anchor it. I accept the all-neutral tonal scheme because a calm look suits a law interview. I accept the shoes cutting the leg line because they ground the suit. I accept the bag and scarf both being print sources because they are quiet and neutral. I accept the suit's price because it is spread over many outfits.
